national_news.title: PM Modi Announces Free Online Coaching for Competitive Exams Aspirants
bullets: Free online coaching to be provided to students from poor and middle-class families.
Aims to ease the financial burden of aspirants preparing for competitive exams.
Expected to save thousands of crore rupees for middle-class families on coaching classes.

national_news.title: SURYAPATH TIRANGA Global Relay concludes after journey across 54 countries
bullets: The Suryapath Tiranga initiative was celebrated as part of the Har Ghar Tiranga campaign.
The relay carried the spirit of the Tiranga from one sunrise to the next, bringing together the Indian community and friends of India across the world.
The relay was launched from the High Commission of India in Fiji and ended in the United States.

national_news.title: Magnus Carlsen wins Esports World Cup chess title for second consecutive year
bullets: Magnus Carlsen won the Esports World Cup title for the second year in a row by defeating Denis Lazavik 2-0.
He remained undefeated throughout the entire tournament, representing Team Liquid.
American Grandmaster Hikaru Nakamura secured third place after defeating Alireza Firouzja 4-1.

national_news.title: PM Modi announces target of 100 Giga Watt Nuclear capacity by 2047 on Independence Day
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced a target of 100 gigawatts of nuclear power capacity by 2047.
The celebrations commemorated 150 years of the enduring legacy of the National Song 'Vande Mataram'.
For the first time, 'Vande Mataram' was rendered during the celebrations at Red Fort.

national_news.title: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio praises India-US ties
bullets: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio extended congratulations to the people of India on Independence Day.
He stated that the India-US relationship continues to grow and is stronger than ever.
Bilateral collaboration is making both nations and the broader Indian Ocean region safer, stronger, and more prosperous.

national_news.title: US State Secretary extends greetings to people of India on Independence Day
bullets: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio extended congratulations to the people of India on Independence Day.
The India-US relationship continues to grow and is stronger than ever, thanks to the personal relationship between US President Donald Trump and Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
Bilateral collaboration is making both nations, and the broader Indian Ocean region, safer, stronger, and more prosperous.

national_news.title: Sports Minister encourages MY-Bharat NSS volunteers to participate in building Viksit Bharat
bullets: Youth Affairs and Sports Minister Dr Mansukh Mandaviya interacted with MY Bharat-NSS volunteers during Independence Day celebrations.
Dr Mandaviya emphasized the importance of young people's energy, commitment, and innovative ideas in achieving a developed and self-reliant India.
The programme aimed to encourage volunteers to participate in initiatives aimed at building a Viksit Bharat.

national_news.title: Country's exports register robust growth of over 13% in July
bullets: Total exports, including merchandise and services, estimated at 80.14 billion US dollars in July.
Merchandise shipments jumped over 19.6% to 44.24 billion US dollars from a year earlier.
Growth in merchandise exports driven by petroleum products, electronic goods, and engineering goods.

national_news.title: Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan to begin two-day visit to Tamil Nadu today
bullets: Vice-President CP Radhakrishnan will participate in academic, commemorative, and literary events in Chennai, Chengalpattu, Thiruvarur, and Thanjavur.
He will attend the 22nd Convocation of the SRM Institute of Science and Technology in Chengalpattu.
The Vice-President will also attend the release of the book ‘Echoes of a Nationalist Mind’ in Chennai.

national_news.title: 12-day Shri Buddha Amarnath Yatra 2026 to begin tomorrow
bullets: The 12-day long annual Shri Buddha Amarnath Yatra 2026 will begin tomorrow and continue until August 28, 2026.
The first batch of pilgrims will depart from the Bhagwati Nagar Yatri Niwas in Jammu toward the border district of Poonch tomorrow.
Authorities have enforced strict multi-tier security and surveillance across Poonch, Rajouri, and transit routes.

national_news.title: Independence Day celebrated across the country with national pride and patriotic fervour
bullets: The 80th Independence Day was celebrated in Maharashtra with patriotic fervour.
Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis highlighted the government’s commitment to development and welfare, particularly for farmers, workers, women and the youth.
The celebrations also carried a message of collective responsibility towards building a stronger and more developed Maharashtra.

national_news.title: All India Radio Code for Content
bullets: Criticism of friendly countries is not allowed.
Attack on religions or communities is not allowed.
Anything obscene or defamatory is not allowed.

national_news.title: Raksha Shakti key to achieving the goal of Viksit Bharat, says Prime Minister
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi emphasized the importance of 'Raksha Shakti' in achieving the goal of Viksit Bharat.
India aims to become a global supplier of next-gen defence technology.
The government is working on Mission Sudarshan Chakra to enhance military capabilities.

national_news.title: Anand Vihar, Udhna Railway Stations To Get Large Passenger Holding Areas Before Festival Rush
bullets: Indian Railways is accelerating work on passenger holding areas at Anand Vihar Terminal and Udhna Railway Station.
The infrastructure upgrade aims to manage the festival rush and improve passenger experience.
The project is part of the Ministry of Railways' efforts to enhance passenger facilities and services.

national_news.title: Squadron Leader Sudhir Kumar awarded Shaurya Chakra for recovering Su-30MKI jet
bullets: Squadron Leader Sudhir Kumar received the Shaurya Chakra for his bravery in recovering a Su-30MKI jet from a definite crash.
This award is a testament to his exceptional service and dedication to the Indian Air Force.
The Su-30MKI jet is a critical component of India's air defense system, and its recovery is a significant achievement.

national_news.title: Government Removes 12-Minute Advertisement Duration Cap for Television Channels
bullets: The 12-minute advertisement duration cap was introduced in 2006 under the Cable Television Networks Rules, 1994.
The removal of the cap aims to enable fair competition and ensure ease of doing business in the TV broadcasting sector.
The TV broadcasting sector has undergone significant changes since the introduction of the cap, with the number of TV channels increasing from 62 in 2006 to a much higher number.

national_news.title: PIB Dehradun urges citizens to join 'Har Ghar Tiranga' campaign
bullets: The 'Har Ghar Tiranga' campaign is a nationwide initiative to promote the tricolor flag.
PIB Dehradun is urging citizens to join the campaign and hoist the national flag at their homes.
The campaign aims to create a sense of patriotism and national pride among citizens.

national_news.title: Amrit Udyan opens for public visit for summer annuals edition 2026
bullets: Amrit Udyan in Rashtrapati Bhavan has opened for public visit for the Amrit Udyan Summer Annuals Edition, 2026.
It will remain open till September 15 this year.
President Droupadi Murmu had graced the opening of Amrit Udyan Summer Annuals Edition on Thursday.

national_news.title: DRI Busts Illegal Areca Nut Import Network, Uncovers Potential Rs 2,500 Crore Revenue Loss
bullets: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) busted an illegal areca nut import network.
The network was exploiting SAFTA duty exemption, leading to a potential revenue loss of Rs 2,500 crore.
Nine people were arrested in connection with the case.

national_news.title: DRI uncovers large-scale illegal use of SAFTA agreement in areca imports
bullets: DRI investigation reveals defrauding exchequer of over Rs. 2,500 crore.
Rs. 75 lakh cash, 160 MT areca nuts seized, and nine people arrested.
Syndicates mis-declared country of origin as Bangladesh to import areca nuts from Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia, and other South-East Asian countries.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Pays Tribute to Freedom Fighters and Patriots
bullets: Bihar CM pays tribute to freedom fighters and patriots who sacrificed their lives for the country's independence.
The Bihar government is working continuously to improve the welfare of all castes, including Mahadalit, Dalit, Backward, and Extremely Backward.
The government's efforts aim to bring prosperity to the lives of these communities.
